transport: UTF-8 JSON-lines: the verifier sends one complete-set predict request followed by EOF. solution/main.py emits exactly one newline-terminated finite JSON object and exits with code zero. Existing for-line entries remain compatible. Extra stdout is invalid; stderr is bounded diagnostics.
execution: Offline unprivileged Python subprocess in the verifier container; frozen solution is read-only and a temporary working directory is writable. Solution and scorer share the same user and filesystem. No root, chroot, UID switch, seccomp or filesystem isolation from reference labels is provided. Intended for trusted internal submissions; answer lookup remains prohibited.
software: Offline CPU Python 3.11 with the operator-provided numerical libraries. Bundle pure-Python dependencies and frozen model assets inside solution/. Sibling imports are supported; resolve asset paths relative to __file__. Numerical thread counts are set from inference_limits; total resources and networking are supplied by the outer verifier container.
final_inputs: The prediction request sends all final target-free records. Reference labels remain under verifier/test/data/.
scoring: Every test record counted once in absolute error mean; auxiliary per-ligand groups count a record once in each ligand group it contains. Missing, duplicate or extra IDs and nonfinite/boolean values are invalid.
